name: Law
overview: Scripture reveals that the Law was divinely given through Moses on Mount Sinai, where God's powerful presence was manifest with thunder and lightning, underscoring the Law's sacred authority (Exodus 19:16; 20:1). The Law, engraved on stone tablets and containing commandments such as the exclusive worship of God (Exodus 20:3; 24:12), was intended to guide God's people and was to be continually remembered and taught, symbolized by its being placed on hand and forehead as a sign of obedience and remembrance (Exodus 13:9, 16). This Law was given because of transgressions and served as a covenantal foundation preserved in the ark of the covenant, emphasizing its central role in the life and identity of God’s people.
